qe: Tikuli art, a craft of Patna revived from an 800-year-old tradition, is made on which base material?
qh: पटना की 800 वर्ष पुरानी परंपरा से पुनर्जीवित टिकुली कला किस आधार-सामग्री पर बनाई जाती है?
e: Tikuli art Patna kshetra ki ek purani kala hai; 'tikuli' shabd ka sambandh tikli ya kaanch ke chhote tukron se hai, isliye ismein kaanch (glass) ke adhaar par rang-birange chitra tatha design banaye jaate hain. Purane samay me mahilaayein mathe par tikuli lagati thi tatha uski sajavat ke liye aisi kalakari hoti thi; samay ke saath yah kala kam ho gayi thi, lekin Patna ke kalakaron, khaas taur par Ashok Kumar Biswas, ke prayason se ise dobara jeevit kiya gaya. Aaj tikuli par Radha-Krishna, Buddha, machhli tatha lok-aakritiyon ke chitra bana kar wall hangings, aise chitra bana kar wall hangings tatha gift items banaye jaate hain, jo desh-videsh me bikte hain. Clay pots par Mithila ki mitti-kala, bamboo se Sikki, pital se Barh ki brass work tatha Gaya se patthar ki murtiyan judi hain - isliye Tikuli ke liye kaanch hi sahi hai. Exam point: Tikuli art = Patna ki kaanch (glass) par bani lok-kala, lagbhag 800 varsh purani parampara se punarjeevit; Ashok Kumar Biswas is kala ke jane-jaane kalakar hain.

qe: Manjusha art, a folk painting tradition, belongs to which region of Bihar?
qh: लोक-चित्रकला परंपरा मंजूषा कला बिहार के किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: Manjusha art Bihar ka ek lok-chitran (folk painting) hai jo Anga kshetra, mukhya roop se Bhagalpur tatha uske aas-paas ke ilaake se juda hai; ise 'Karnamandal' kala bhi kaha jaata hai, kyunki iska sambandh Karn tatha Bihula ki lok-katha se jodkar dekha jaata hai. Isme manjusha (ek patra ya dabi) ke aakaran ke bhande tatha kagaz par lambi tatha seedhi lines ke beech chhote-chhote chitra banaye jaate hain; rang mukhya roop se teen hote hain - hariyali (green), peela (yellow) tatha gulaabi (pink). Yah kala Bihula-Bishhari ki puja se judi hai, isliye iska naam Manasa devi ki katha se bhi joda jaata hai. Mithila ki Madhubani chitrakala tatha Sikki kala, Magadh ke tilkut tatha Saran ke Sonepur mela anya pehchan hain - isliye Manjusha ke liye Anga kshetra (Bhagalpur) hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Manjusha art (Karnamandal kala) = Anga kshetra, Bhagalpur; rang mukhya roop se teen - green, yellow tatha pink; Bihula-Bishhari lok-katha se judi lok-chitrakala; Madhubani painting Mithila ki alag kala hai.

qe: Godna painting, a style painted on canvas by Dalit artists, was pioneered mainly by which artist from Bihar?
qh: दलित कलाकारों द्वारा कैनवास पर बनाई जाने वाली गोदना चित्रकला को मुख्य रूप से बिहार की किस कलाकार ने आगे बढ़ाया?
e: Godna kala mool roop se shareer par godne (tattoo) jaisi parampara se nikli hai; aadivasi tatha dalit samudayon me godna banwana ek purani parampara rahi hai, jisme sabhi aay ke log apne shareer par aakritiyan gotwate the. Chano Devi ne isi parampara ko kagaz tatha canvas par utara tatha 'Godna painting' ko pehchan dilai; woh Raja Salhesh ki lok-kathayein tatha samaajik samanata ke sandesh apne chitron me dikhati hain. Isi parampara ko aage badhane me Shanti Devi tatha Shivan Paswan ki jodi ko 2024 me Padma Shri mila, jinhone godna kala ko videshon me bhi prasiddh kiya. Mahasundari Devi tatha Baua Devi Mithila (Madhubani) chitrakala ki kalakar hain tatha Dulari Devi ko bhi isi Mithila kala ke liye Padma Shri mila - isliye Godna painting ke liye Chano Devi hi sahi uttar hain. Exam point: Godna painting = Dalit-aadivasi godna (tattoo) parampara se canvas tak layi gayi kala; pramukh kalakar Chano Devi; Shanti Devi tatha Shivan Paswan ko 2024 me sanyukt Padma Shri; Mahasundari Devi-Baua Devi-Dulari Devi Mithila kala ki kalakar hain.

qe: Applique (Khatwa) patchwork, which has a GI tag, is a craft in which pieces of cloth are:
qh: जीआई टैग प्राप्त कथवा (अप्लीके) पैचवर्क वह शिल्प है जिसमें कपड़े के टुकड़ों को:
oe: knitted with wool on hand machines
printed with wooden blocks and dyed in indigo
cut into shapes and stitched on a base fabric by hand
woven on a powerloom with jute yarn
oh: हाथ की मशीनों पर ऊन से बुना जाता है
लकड़ी के छापों से छापा जाता है तथा नील में रंगा जाता है
आकृतियों में काटकर मूल कपड़े पर हाथ से सिला जाता है
जूट के धागे से पॉवरलूम पर बुना जाता है
e: Khatwa (Applique) shilp me ek mool kapde (base fabric) ke upar alag-alag rangon ke kapdon ko geometric, phool-patti ya pashu-pakshi ke aakaron me kaat kar badee bareeki se haath se sila jaata hai, isliye ise patchwork ya applique kaha jaata hai. Yah kala Bihar me poori tarah haath ke kaam par adhaarit hai; Mughal tatha British kaal me shahi khaimon (tents) tatha shamiyane isi technique se sajaye jaate the. Is kala ko 2007 me GI (Geographical Indication) tag mila tatha iske mukhya cluster Patna (Fatuha), Muzaffarpur tatha Madhubani kshetra me hain; NIFT jaisi sansthaon ne ise aadhunik fashion se jodne me madad ki. Powerloom par bunai, wooden block printing tatha wool knitting anya prakar ki kalaen hain - isliye Khatwa ke liye 'aakritiyon me kaat kar haath se sina' hi sahi hai. Exam point: Khatwa/Applique = mool kapde par kaate hue tukdon ko haath se sine ki kala, GI tag 2007, mukhya cluster Patna (Fatuha), Muzaffarpur tatha Madhubani; Mughal-British kaaleen tents isi se bante the.

qe: Bawan Buti saree, which got a GI tag in 2023, is woven in which district of Bihar and contains how many traditional motifs?
qh: 2023 में जीआई टैग पाने वाली बावन बूटी साड़ी बिहार के किस जिले में बुनी जाती है तथा उसमें कितनी पारंपरिक बूटियाँ होती हैं?
e: Bawan Buti saree Nalanda jile ke Baswanbigha tatha Bihar Sharif kshetra me hathkargha (handloom) par bunti jaati hai; 'Bawan' ka arth hai 52 tatha 'Buti' ka arth hai chhoti chhitri ya design, isliye is saree me 52 paramparik butiyan (aakritiyan) bunti jaati hain. Iski khaas baat yah hai ki ek-ek buti haath se bunne me bahut samay lagta hai - ek saree taiyar karne me lagbhag 8 se 10 din ka kathin shram lagta hai. Kaha jaata hai ki bharat ke pratham Rashtrapati Dr. Rajendra Prasad, jo Bihar se the, unhone Rashtrapati Bhavan ke parde tatha table linen isi kala se banwaye the; 2023 me ise GI tag mila. Bhagalpur tussar silk ke liye, Darbhanga makhana ke liye tatha Gaya Patharkatti patthar-kala ke liye jaana jaata hai - isliye Bawan Buti ke liye 'Nalanda, bavan' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Bawan Buti saree = Nalanda (Baswanbigha, Bihar Sharif belt), 52 butiyan haath se buni jaati hain, GI tag 2023; Dr. Rajendra Prasad ke samay Rashtrapati Bhavan me iska upyog.

qe: Pattharkatti stone craft, which received a GI tag in 2023, belongs to which district of Bihar?
qh: 2023 में जीआई टैग प्राप्त पत्थरकट्टी पाषाण शिल्प बिहार के किस जिले का है?
e: Pattharkatti Gaya jile ka ek gaon (Khizirsarai/Atri kshetra) hai jahan sadiyon se patthar tarashne ki anokhi parampara chali aati hai; 2023 me is kala ko GI tag mila. Yahan ke shilpakar kaale 'kasauti' patthar tatha blue-black granite ko chheni-hathode se tarash kar Bhagwan Buddha, Bhagwan Vishnu tatha anya devi-devtaon ki sundar murtiyan banate hain. Bodh Gaya aane wale videshi Buddhist yatri (Thailand, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, Japan se) in murtiyon ko apne desh le jaate hain, isliye yah kala aarthik roop se bhi mahatvapurn hai. Lok-kathaon ke anusar 18vein sadi me Gaya ke Vishnupad mandir ke nirman ke liye Indore ki Maharani Ahilyabai Holkar ne is kshetra me shilpakaron ko basaya tha; saans ki bimaari (silicosis) in shilpakaron ke liye ek badi samasya hai. Rohtas, Nawada tatha Munger anya patthar tatha khanij kshetra hain, lekin Pattharkatti kala Gaya se judi hai, isliye sahi uttar Gaya hai. Exam point: Pattharkatti stone craft = Gaya jila (Khizirsarai/Atri kshetra), GI tag 2023, kaale kasauti patthar tatha shilpkaron ki paramparik murti-kala; Bodh Gaya ke Buddhist yatri iske mukhya grahak hain.

qe: Sikki grass craft of Mithila, called 'golden grass', is used to make which of the following items?
qh: मिथिला की 'सुनहरी घास' कहलाने वाली सिक्की घास शिल्प से क्या बनाया जाता है?
e: Sikki grass (jise 'Golden Grass' ya sunhari ghaas kaha jaata hai) Mithilanchal ke talabon, dhabon tatha jheelon ke kinare barsaat ke baad natural roop se ugti hai; sukhane ke baad isme sone jaisi chamak aa jaati hai. Gaon ki mahilayein is ghaas ko pehle geela karke mulayam karti hain, phir patli doriyon me baant kar tokriyan, dabbe, jewellery box, coaster tatha sajavat ki wall-plates banai jaati hain. 'Pauti' naam ka aisa hi utpad Mithila ke vivaah sanskar me shubh maana jaata hai, isliye yah kala lok-parampara ka hissa hai; 2007 me Sikki ko GI tag mila. Loha ke auzar tatha tale, kaanch ki chudiyan tatha unke darpan, tatha chamde ke joote-bag alag shilp hain - isliye sahi uttar 'tokriyan, dabbe tatha sajavat ke utpad' hai. Exam point: Sikki grass craft = Mithila, 'Golden Grass' ke naam se prasiddh, GI tag 2007; isse tokri, dabbe tatha sajavat ke utpad bante hain; vivaah me 'Pauti' ka upyog shubh maana jaata hai.

qe: Silao, which got a GI tag for its 'khaja' sweet, is a town in which district of Bihar?
qh: अपने 'खाजा' मिष्ठान के लिए जीआई टैग पाने वाला सिलाव बिहार के किस जिले का कस्बा है?
e: Silao Nalanda jile ka ek qasba hai jo Rajgir tatha Bihar Sharif marg par sthit hai; yahan ka 'Silao Khaja' apni parat-dar (layered) banawat tatha meethas ke liye rajya bhar me prasiddh hai. 2018 me 'Silao Khaja' ko GI (Geographical Indication) tag mila, jisse is mithai ke naam ke saath uske kshetra ka vishesh rishta jud gaya. Lok-kathaon ke anusar Magadha samrajya tatha Gautam Buddha ke samay se hi is kshetra me khaja banane ki parampara maani jaati hai; aaj bhi yahan ke kaarigar aata, cheeni tatha ghee se haath se khaja banate hain tatha Rajgir aane wale yatree ise shauk se kharidte hain. Patna, Gaya tatha Begusarai ke bhi apne prasiddh khane hain (jaise Gaya ka tilkut), lekin Silao khaja Nalanda jile se juda hai, isliye sahi uttar Nalanda hai. Exam point: Silao Khaja (GI 2018) = Nalanda jila, Rajgir-Bihar Sharif marg par sthit qasba; Rajgir tatha Bodh Gaya jaane wale yatree ise kharidte hain.

qe: Papier-mache (Kutti art) of Madhubani, for which Subhadra Devi received the Padma Shri in 2023, is made by using:
qh: मधुबनी की पेपर-माशे (कुट्टी कला), जिसके लिए सुभद्रा देवी को 2023 में पद्म श्री मिला, किस सामग्री से बनाई जाती है?
oh: भट्ठियों में पिघलाया लोहे का कबाड़
रद्दी कागज से बनाया गया गूदा (pulp)
e: Papier-mache kala me raddi (waste) kagaz ko paani me bhigokar geela kiya jaata hai tatha uske gude (pulp) me gond tatha anya saamagri milakar ek lai taiyar ki jaati hai; isi lai se khilone, murtiyan, dabi tatha sajavat ke samaan banaye jaate hain. Madhubani ki Subhadra Devi ne isi 'Kutti art' ko naya jeevan diya, jisme kagaz ke gude ke saath kutti (kaat kar banaye chhote tukde) milakar teen-aayami (3D) aakritiyan banai jaati hain; unhe 2023 me Padma Shri mila. Yah kala paryavaran ke liye achhi hai kyunki isme kabad (waste) kagaz ka upyog hota hai tatha gaon ki mahilaon ko gharelu aay ka zariya bhi deta hai. Loha pighlane wali kala, baans ki patti se Sikki jaise utpad tatha sangmarmar-ya cement ki murtiyan alag shilp hain - isliye sahi uttar 'raddi kagaz ka guda (pulp)' hai. Exam point: Papier-mache/Kutti art = Madhubani, raddi kagaz ke gude (pulp) se teen-aayami khilone tatha murtiyan; Subhadra Devi ko 2023 me Padma Shri; yah kala paryavaran-anukool tatha gaon ki mahilaon ke liye aay ka srot hai.
